lines.name: Color Touch
lines.description: Wella Professionals' most versatile demi-permanent hair colour. Ammonia-free, silicone-free, mineral oil-free, vegan emulsion. Up to 85% naturally derived ingredients. Built-in Metal Purifier encapsulates metals for true-to-tone vibrancy. Up to 70% grey coverage with soft regrowth. Lasts up to 28 washes.

developers.name: Color Touch Emulsion 1.9%
developers.use: Same depth or darkening, soft regrowth, toning blondes, soft grey blending

developers.name: Color Touch Emulsion 4%
developers.use: Increased vibrancy, coarse hair, intense grey blending, up to 70% grey coverage (with Plus), low lift

categories.pure-naturals: Natural base shades for coverage and depth
categories.rich-naturals: Fashion naturals with reflect — ash, gold, violet, pearl, cendre
categories.deep-browns: Warm and cool brown reflects (/7 series)
categories.vibrant-reds: Copper, red, violet intense shades — includes double-pigment shades (XX/YY format)
categories.special-mix: Concentrated boosters — Copper, Red, Violet, Matte, Ash

applicationNotes: Pairs seamlessly with Koleston Perfect for regrowth + Color Touch on lengths/ends
For toning: process until desired neutralization is achieved visually

lines.name: Color Touch Plus
lines.description: Increased grey coverage variant of Color Touch. Alkaline formula with MEA and low-ammonia for up to 70% grey coverage with soft regrowth line. Apply to dry hair.

developers.name: Color Touch Emulsion 4%
developers.use: Up to 70% grey coverage. Apply to dry hair.

notes: Only available in natural shades at levels 4-8 (XX/07 format)
Apply to DRY hair (unlike standard Color Touch)
Contains MEA and low ammonia for increased coverage

toneSystem.description: Wella International Tone Numbering: Level/Tone format (e.g., 7/43 = level 7 copper-gold)
toneSystem.doublePigment: XX/YY format — first two digits = level with doubled pigment intensity (e.g., 66/44 = level 6 intense red-copper)

specialNotes: Color Touch is Wella's #1 demi-permanent — pairs with Koleston Perfect for full service
Double-pigment shades (XX/YY) provide intensified color — use for vibrancy on pre-lightened or resistant hair
Metal Purifier technology encapsulates metals on hair for accurate color formation
Color Touch Plus (XX/07) is the increased grey coverage variant — apply to DRY hair
Special Mix boosters (0/XX) are concentrated — use up to 50g per 30g of base shade
